text: {"lessons":["I should assess each holding by its future prospects and portfolio role, rather than hold it merely to avoid realizing a loss.","My sale of Stock E at a loss was painful; I should make decisions based on current information, not my average cost or the emotional appeal of locking in gains.","Short-term account swings are not a reliable signal to trade; I should remain disciplined, consider diversification and risk, and avoid unnecessary changes."]}
